subject: Roberts School Safety and Enrollment Concerns
overview: The committee addressed safety concerns at Roberts Elementary School following reports of violent incidents in a third-grade classroom and discussed a $400,000 grant for the Complete Streets traffic safety initiative.

items.title: routine business
items.summary: Approved previous meeting minutes, bill transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: community participation on roberts school safety
items.summary: Parent Cheryl Rodriguez described traumatic incidents involving violent behavioral outbursts in a third-grade classroom at Roberts Elementary and criticized the lack of communication from school administration.

items.title: administrative response to roberts school incidents
items.summary: Superintendent Belson and staff detailed plans for student evaluations and de-escalation strategies, clarifying that the incidents involved students without special education plans.

items.title: committee action on school safety and population
items.summary: Approved several motions requiring the Roberts School principal to appear before the committee, reviewing class size allocations, and mandating a meeting with parents.

items.title: recognitions and commendations
items.summary: Recognized community events including the Mystic River Celebration and the Crystal Campbell Peace Garden dedication, and commended outgoing Director of Administration and Finance Patricia Bailey.

items.title: complete streets grant and traffic safety
items.summary: Mayor Burke announced a $400,000 state grant to implement safety improvements including flash beacons and curb bump-outs at the Brooks School and other city intersections.

items.title: fellsway crossing guards
items.summary: Approved a motion to request that the state delegation and Department of Conservation and Recreation provide crossing guards at intersections on the Fellsway.
